c.st: Why Is Spoofing Bad?
c.x:
Absolutely if you are a large block trader your dream scenario is a very liquid market with very inefficient price discovery.

Dark Pools were meant to provide that, but it turns out that in practice it didn't work (because no one wants to provide liquidity in that environment) and Dark Pools ended up resorting to either letting liquidity providers in, going out of business, or extremely scammy things to keep up the ruse.
